metadata.title: ai-product-operating-model - Primary Sources
metadata.description: Primary operating-model, provider-control, and governance references refreshed for July 2026. Corrected A2A protocol status (now Linux Foundation, v1.0 stable), EU AI Act Digital Omnibus adoption status, and softened volatile model-name claims.

operating_model.name: A2A Protocol (Agent-to-Agent)
operating_model.description: Inter-agent task-delegation standard complementing MCP. MCP defines tool/context boundaries; A2A defines agent-to-agent task handoff. Now a Linux Foundation project (moved from the original google.github.io/A2A URL, which is stale); reached a stable v1.0 with signed Agent Cards and multi-cloud adoption. Verify current version and adoption footprint before relying on it as a production routing backbone.

model_lifecycle.name: Anthropic Models Overview
model_lifecycle.description: Canonical source for current and deprecated Anthropic model IDs, deprecation notices, and migration guidance. Model family names and tiers (e.g. Haiku/Sonnet/Opus and any higher tier) churn on a roughly quarterly cadence — do not hardcode a specific model name or ID in platform config or documentation; always re-verify against this page at build/deploy time.

governance_extensions.name: EU AI Act Digital Omnibus Deadline Extension (Gibson Dunn / White & Case, mid-2026)
governance_extensions.description: Legal briefings confirming the May 7, 2026 political agreement (European Parliament endorsed June 16, 2026; Council final sign-off June 29, 2026): Annex III high-risk systems (new/substantially modified) get a 16-month extension to Dec 2, 2027; Annex I AI safety components get a 12-month extension to Aug 2, 2028; Article 50(2) AI-generated-content marking/detection duties get a transition extension to Dec 2, 2026 for systems already on the market before Aug 2, 2026. Treat as adopted pending official-journal publication, not as a pending proposal.
